items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: guys like Yellow Car/ (PHONETIC) and all these people.

ctx.x: There were a lot of slick things we were doing, man. And they had --home boy, whom they didn't know was a home boy, guys like Yellow Car/ (PHONETIC) and all these people. Yellow Car/would go (unintelligible) "Now, don't you bother this -- you fellows stop that now." And he'd get next to the cop and take his gun and take him around the corner and beat him, beat him to death. "Don't you bother this -- you know, I've got this shop up here." (Inaudible).

You see, anytime something -- things like doing two minute things to something white in America, they're going to stop that. They going to let him alone, see. They're going to let him alone. They love to see other people's blood be flowing, but when this other man says, well, I want his mother to do a bit of crying too (audible). That's what happened.
